_comment: Axle's own settled ledger, transcribed from the transactions list in the Axle app. This is the money Axle has actually paid, and it is what the site publishes. The per-day 'axle' blocks in data/daily/*.json are our own metered-export estimate captured by Home Assistant during each dispatch - useful for the kWh story, but not the payment. They disagree by a few percent (different metering and settlement), and where they disagree the ledger wins. Types: event = grid-balancing dispatch, topup = monthly payment bringing the month up to the GBP 10 minimum, withdrawal = cash taken out of the Axle balance (not earnings, ignored in the totals).
